statement: The actual elliptic ambient-metabelian class-three quotient of E50 and the genuine h-induced class-three quotient of E54 have maximal common quotient C/<c^3,d^3,e>. Their exact fiber product is a quotient of the intrinsic rank-ten class-three group by the actual abelian group Z_3^329, with saturated kernel graded ranks0,27,302 and quotient ranks10,18,28. The common based Galois action is explicitly cyclotomic, and its Frobenius4 images are x^4,y^4 c,c d,d.
where_proved: sections/E_combined_quotient.tex, E53.1-E53.15 and complete proof; code/a_combined_quotient.py/.out/.json
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v-736v, scans172-178, equations(371)-(379), Part E(c),(d)
notes: The two actual maps use the common source tangent and the distinct, explicitly transported target tangents of E50 and E54. Their geometric kernels and arithmetic actions are preserved.
The positive peripheral valuation matrix has exact image3Z3 x+Z3 y. The saved unimodular cusp basis change retains this factor3.

The image of I contains gamma2F because the h map is onto and N-prime is contained in I. Its image in C is precisely <x^3,y,c,d,e>. Its actual derived group is <c^3,d^3,e>, as verified by [x^3,y]=c^3d^3, [x^3,c]=d^3 and[y,c]=e.
The maximal common quotient is the quotient by the actual product of compact kernels. Correcting a lift by an element of K0 proves surjectivity to the fiber product.

The group-level kernel is the kernel of a surjection Z3^332->Z3^3, hence is Z3^329. The degree-three image equals3Z3d+Z3e, which is also the intersection of the full image with gamma3C. Actual preimages [a,w],[b,w] prove strictness, so the graded-kernel assertions precede and justify the rank subtraction.

The integer Hall certificate gives literal kernel bases and integer right inverses. The chosen handle/cusp splitting is explicitly a coordinate choice, while all actual maps and kernels remain G_K-equivariant.
In the common quotient x^3 is central. The genuine congruence k=(chi-1)/3 mod3 therefore makes the entire based action factor through chi, with its generator images computed in the theorem.
The result combines two exact quotients and retains the remaining intrinsic kernel; no complete higher intrinsic arithmetic action is asserted.
